title: 16# Yusha Bin Noon & Dawood A.S
arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ اَفَتَاهُ’ وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَاهُ

لم یبقی معه احد ممن عبدالعجل رمي حجر أنت مأمورةٌ وأنا مأمورٌ غزا نبيٌّ من الأنبياءِ ، فقال لقومِه : لا يتبعُني رجلٌ قد ملك بُضعَ امرأةٍ ، وهو يُريدُ أن يبنيَ بها ولم يبْنِ

ولا آخرُ قد بنَى بنيانًا ولمَّا يرفَعْ سقفَها فغزا ، فأدنَى من لقريةِ حين صلاةِ العصرِ ، أو قريبًا من ذلك ، فقال للشَّمسِ : أنت مأمورةٌ وأنا مأمورٌ ،

اللَّهمَّ احبِسْها عليَّ شيئًا ، فحُبِست عليه ، حتَّى فتح اللهُ عليه ، لا إلهَ إلاَّ اللَّه Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الْمَلَإِ مِن بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِن بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰ إِذْ قَالُوا لِنَبِيٍّ لَّهُمُ ابْعَثْ لَنَا مَلِكًا

قَالَ هَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِن كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْقِتَالُ أَلَّا تُقَاتِلُوا ۖ وَمَا لَنَا أَلَّا نُقَاتِلَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَقَدْ أُخْرِجْنَا مِن دِيَارِنَا وَأَبْنَائِنَا ۖ

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَلَمَّا كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقِتَالُ تَوَلَّوْا إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّنْهُمْ ۗ وَقَالَ لَهُمْ نَبِيُّهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ بَعَثَ لَكُمْ طَالُوتَ مَلِكًا ۚ

قَالُوا أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ عَلَيْنَا وَنَحْنُ أَحَقُّ بِالْمُلْكِ مِنْهُ وَلَمْ يُؤْتَ سَعَةً مِّنَ الْمَالِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَاهُ عَلَيْكُمْ

إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَاهُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَزَادَهُ بَسْطَةً فِي الْعِلْمِ وَالْجِسْمِ ۖ وَزَادَهُ بَسْطَةً فِي الْعِلْمِ وَالْجسْد وَاللَّهُ يُؤْتِي مُلْكَهُ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ

وَقَالَ لَهُمْ نَبِيُّهُمْ إِنَّ ءَايَةَ مُلْكِهِۦٓ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ ٱلتَّابُوتُ فِيهِ سَكِينَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَبَقِيَّةٌ وَبَقِيَّةٌ مِّمَّا تَرَكَ ءَالُ مُوسَىٰ وَءَالُ هَٰرُونَ تَحْمِلُهُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ ۚ

إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ۝

فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِالْجُنُودِ فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِالْجُنُودِ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَلَوْ أَرَادُوا الْخُرُوجَ لَأَعَدُّوا لَهُ عُدَّةً

لَأَعَدُّوا لَهُ عُدَّةً وَلَوْ أَرَادُوا الْخُرُوجَ لَأَعَدُّوا لَهُ عُدَّةً وَلَٰكِن كَرِهَ اللَّهُ انبِعَاثَهُمْ فَثَبَّطَهُمْ وَقِيلَ اقْعُدُوا مَعَ الْقَاعِدِينَ۝

لَوْ خَرَجُواْ فِيكُم مَّا زَادُوكُمْ إِلَّا خَبَالًا فَثَبَّطَهُمْ خَبَالًا لن نغلب الیوم القلۃ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍ مَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّي

وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُ مِنِّي إِلَّا مَنِ اغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةً بِيَدِهِ ۚ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُ هُوَ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ قَالُوا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا الْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِ ۚ

قَالَ الَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَاقُو اللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةً كَثِيرَةً بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ۗ ثلاثمائة وعشرة وَلَمَّا بَرَزُوا لِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِ

جَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِ قَالُوا رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا

وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ۝

فِئَةٍ قَلِيلَةٍ وَالطَّالُوت Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَهَزَمُوهُم بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَقَتَلَ دَاوُودُ جَالُوتَ وَآتَاهُ اللَّهُ الْمُلْكَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَعَلَّمَهُ مِمَّا يَشَاءُ ۗ

وَعَلَّمَهُ مِمَّا يَشَاءُ ۗ عَلَّمَهُ مِمَّا يَشَاءُ ۗ لقد أوتيت مزمارا من مزامير آل داود Suhuf Ibrahim(صُحُف اِبْراهِيْم); Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says;

وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ مِنَّا فَضْلًا ۖ يَا جِبَالُ أَوِّبِي مَعَهُ وَالطَّيْرَ ۖ وَيُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ

يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَأَلَنَّا لَهُ الْحَدِيدَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَعَلَّمْنَٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍۢ لَّكُمْ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; لِتُحْصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأْسِكُمْ أَنِ اعْمَلْ سَابِغَاتٍ وَقَدِّرْ فِي السَّرْدِ ۖ

وَقَدِّرْ فِي السَّرْدِ ۖ So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is telling Dawoodعليه السلام; وَقَدِّرْ فِي السَّرْدِ ۖ It's Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

وَعَلَّمْنَٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍۢ لَّكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأْسِكُمْ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُمْ شَٰكِرُونَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said; Be grateful to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ۝

وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ۝

وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ۝

وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ۝

تصورٌمحراب لا تخف وَهَلْ أَتَاكَ نَبَأُ الْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا الْمِحْرَابَ۝

إِذْ دَخَلُواْ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُواْ لَا  تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ

فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ۝

إِنَّ هَٰذَا أَخِي لَهُ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِيَ نَعْجَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي الْخِطَابِ۝

قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ

إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُودُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّاهُ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ۝

يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةً مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَٰلِحًا فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَٰتٍۢ ۗ

فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُواْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ۝

العدل في قلب القاضي اقامت الدين وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا
english:
When Musa(موسى) passed away; the leadership was handed down to Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون); Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) who is mentioned in Qur'an as a servant;

Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) was a servant with Musa(موسى).

Being a servant with Musa(موسى), he was close to the revelation; close to the teacher, and he was a righteous student of this teacher.

So when Musaعليه السلام passed away; the leadership was handed down to, Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون), and Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) is Nabi(نَبِي);

Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) is a Nabi(نَبِي), but he is not mentioned in Qur'an; he is mentioned in the Hadith(حديث) of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

The name of Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) is not in Qur'an, but it is from Hadith(حديث), and it is in the Sahih Hadith(صحيح حديث).

Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون), in English; Joshua.

Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) became the leader of the children of Israel(اسرائيل).

The children of Israel(اسرائيل) were delivered to the Holy Land, and they were victorious; under his leadership.

this did not happen with Musaعليه السلام and it did not happen with Haroon(هارون).

Rather, it happened in the time of Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون).

Musa(موسى) and Haroon(هارون); they passed away when Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) were in the wilderness.

Rasool Allah ﷺ tells us a clue of the reason, why this victory was delayed.

The children of Israel(اسرائيل) who came out from Egypt, were raised up in servitude and slavery.

So, they were weak, and they were not fit for victory.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى made them stay in the wilderness for 40 years.

Until, all of that generation passed away, and a new generation who was raised up in freedom under the leadership and the teaching of Musa(موسى) and Haroon(هارون);

These are the ones who were given the victory to enter Jerusalem.

The ones who were raised up by Musa(موسى) and Haroon(هارون) in a free environment.

Because, the environment in Egypt was not suitable to raise up a generation of victory.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Rasool Ullah says; None of the ones; who worship the calf, entered into Jerusalem.

All of that old generation who worshipped the calf; were dead, a new generation was raised up in the desert; in that harsh environment; under the teachings of Torah(تورة); under the hands of Musa(موسى) and Haroon(هارون);

these are the ones who were qualified for leadership.

We learned something interesting for them.

There's no doubt; that Musa(موسى) is the greatest Nabi(نَبِي) of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

How come did the victory happened in the time of Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون)?

And it tells us, there is not enough to have a leader.

Musa(موسى); is the best that Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) have seen, and he is the founder of this nation.

Nevertheless, victory did not happen on his hands even though he desired it so greatly.

He wanted to enter into the Holy Land.

And we know how much he desired that, that when the angel of death came to take his soul, he hit him, and then; when he knew that this is his appointed time, he said, I will die now

but, oh Allah! Make me die as close to Jerusalem as possible.

Throw of a stone.

He said; If I cannot enter into Jerusalem alive, at least bury me as close as possible to Jerusalem.

But that did not happen in the time of Musa(موسى), because the generation which were with Musa(موسى) did not deserve it.

So now when we keep on thinking that, I mean; we're waiting for Al-Mahdi(ال مهدى); everyone is waiting for Al-Mahdi(المهدى).

It's not an issue of a Al-Mahdi(المهدى); If you're not ready; Al-Mahdi(المهدى) cannot do you anything.

The generation has to be ready and prepared for victory.

It's not an issue of a leader; the generation have to be ready and prepared.

And that's why, Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) were not able to enter into Jerusalem until, there was a suitable generation for victory.

And these are the ones who entered with Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون), and we will see the miracle which Allahسُبحانه وتعالى performed for them.

When you have Allah on your side; don't worry! Allah will do everything for you.

Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) was fighting with Al-Jababirah(الجبابره).

Al-Jababirah(الجبابره) were the people who were living in Jerusalem.

They were giants, powerful, tyrants.

Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) led the children of Israel(اسرائيل) in that battle.

The fighting was furious.

The sun was about to set.

Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) knew, that he would need more time; it's not enough for him.

He cannot win, except if the day is longer.

If they wait for the next day, the army will regroup and attack again.

So he needs the more time.

Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) pointed to the sun and said; You are receiving orders, and I'm receiving orders.

Both of us are receiving orders from Allah; so stop!

He told the sun stop.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى made the sun stop for Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون).

Until he finished, and destroyed the enemy, then the sun started moving again.

If you have Allahسُبحانه وتعالى on your side; don't worry! Allahسُبحانه وتعالى will take care of you.

It's not a matter of numbers, or weapons, or air force, or artillery, or battalions.

If you have Allah with you; Allah will help you.

He pointed to the sun; to stop! It stopped.

And this Hadith(حديث) is narrated by Al-Imam Ahmad(الاِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ).

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Rasool Allah ﷺ says; One of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) went into war, and he told his army; if any one of you just got married, you did not sleep with your wife yet, and you want to; then don't come with me.

And then he said; And if anybody is building a house, and he did not build the roof yet, then don't come with me.

What is the Nabi(نَبِي) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) telling his people; If you got married to a woman, and you did not sleep with her yet, don't come with me.

If you are building a house, and you did not build the roof yet, don't come with me.

If you have bought some pregnant goats or pregnant camels, and you're waiting for them to deliver, don't come with me.

Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) does not want anybody to come with him; if their hearts are attached to something else.

If your heart is with your wife, don't come with me.

If your heart is with your house, don't come with me.

If your heart is with the camels and goats, don't come with me.

He's not looking for numbers; he could gather a crowd and take them to war.

He said; No! I don't want you.

This battle needs people who have, Ikhlas(اِخْلَاص); who have sincerity.

If you're coming, and doing this half-heartedly; stay home.

And then, Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Rasool Allah ﷺ says; He fought; until it was time of Asr(عصر), and then he told the sun; you are receiving orders, and I'm receiving orders, oh Allah! Stop the sun.

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى stop the sun, until he achieved victory, and he won.

This is the story of Sayidina Yusha Bin Noon(سيدنا يوشع بن نون).

They won, and they entered into Jerusalem, and they started expanding their nation; under the banner of; Time past; few generations, maybe a few centuries, and then the enemies were regrouping and attacking again.

And there was a continuous Jihad(جهاد) with Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

Under the leadership of one of their Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء); Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) came to their Nabi(نَبِي), and they told him; Send us a king; so that we can fight under his leadership.
